items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee), and S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel to London and are ruled OUT vs Jaguars.
items.implication: Full backfield and receiving void; Woody Marks previously handled 98% snaps and all touches in Montgomery absence.
items.opportunity: Marks full snap/RB2 upside while Montgomery out; other Texans RBs/WRs elevated.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled OUT for Week 6 vs Panthers due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; out indefinitely pending treatment course. Tanner McKee expected to start.
items.why: Follow-up ultrasound Wednesday night revealed movement in the clot after he played through it in London; health priority.
items.implication: Major downgrade for Eagles offense and Hurts fantasy; McKee start with low implied total ~17.75.
items.opportunity: Panthers DST upgrade; possible short-term boost to remaining Eagles pass-catchers if volume holds but overall ceiling down.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore DNP second straight day (shoulder).
items.implication: Game-time decision risk; Buffalo WR corps thinner if out.
items.opportunity: Other Bills WRs or TE Kincaid elevated targets.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love DNP second straight day (ankle).
items.implication: Unlikely to play or limited; ARI RB depth chart shifts.
items.opportunity: Other Cardinals RBs (if any primary) gain carries; monitor for OUT confirmation.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley no practice again (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited. Combined with Hurts OUT creates major uncertainty for PHI offense.
items.why: Hamstring for Barkley (second straight DNP); Smith hamstring improved to limited.
items.implication: Barkley game-time or OUT risk; Smith more likely but limited role possible. PHI implied total tanks.
items.opportunity: If Barkley OUT, handcuffs/backups elevate; Goedert already seeing high target share.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice DNP again Thursday due to hamstring.
items.why: Hamstring injury continuing to limit practice.
items.implication: Risk of OUT or limited role; KC WR depth (Worthy etc.) elevated if sits.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and other Chiefs pass-catchers gain target share if Rice inactive.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson officially DNP again Thursday (ankle); still has realistic chance to play but status uncertain heading into Friday.
items.why: Second consecutive DNP recovering from ankle that cost Week 5.
items.implication: Huntley likely if out; Ravens offense ceiling lower without Lamar dual-threat.
items.opportunity: Monitor for ACTIVE upgrade; if OUT, Likely/Andrews and WRs still viable but reduced.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day (hamstring), on track to start vs Falcons though still needs clearance tests.
items.why: Full practices Wed/Thu after multi-week absence; confirmed tear but progressing.
items.implication: Likely return upgrades entire Bears offense (Odunze, Moore, Swift, Loveland).
items.opportunity: Bears pass-catchers and RBs regain starter QB volume; high implied total spot.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz etc.). Saquon turns 30 in Feb; if contender with RB need, at least call. Better move year early than late in this situation.
items.why: Age curve + Eagles historical precedent + current hamstring; dynasty/redraft ROS risk.
items.implication: Consider selling high now while value holds if contending teams call; handcuff priority.
items.opportunity: Potential trade market opens; monitor PHI RB depth post any move or extended absence.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans (WR4 vs WSH), Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @ GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ), Brock Purdy (QB2 vs WSH). Soft matchups + volume/roles.
items.why: WSH defense buffet for pass-catchers; elite recent usage for Kyren/Javonte goal-line; Stevenson volume post-Henderson multi-week out; high-scoring environments.
items.implication: Strong start prioritization; Evans especially with Samuel multi-week out boosting targets.
items.opportunity: Evans 36% target share recently + Samuel absence; Stevenson 85% snaps/23 touches in prior full role; Kyren elite usage.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson multi-week high ankle; Stevenson 85% snaps/23 touches prior and 16.3 PPG on 15+ touches. Montgomery OUT → Marks 98% snaps/all touches (better metrics). Tuten snap/util rate rising every week (77 util W5). Evans 36% targets + Samuel multi-week out.
items.why: Direct volume transfers and rising roles confirmed by snaps/targets/util.
items.implication: Stevenson RB1/2 lock; Marks low-end RB2 while Monty out; Tuten flex riser; Evans WR1 upside.
items.opportunity: Clear: Stevenson full workload; Marks every-down; Tuten increasing share; Evans target monopoly without Samuel.

items.text: Since Breece Hall injury (week-to-week, no practice): RB snaps hierarchy clear — Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0 in two full games.
items.why: Clear lead-back snaps for Allen while Hall remains week-to-week.
items.implication: Allen is the primary fantasy play/handcuff elevation in Hall absence; not a committee.
items.opportunity: Allen near every-down role (90 snaps); start with confidence if Hall out.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return with shoulder then returned to TNF game vs Seahawks.
items.why: Shoulder injury mid-game but cleared to return.
items.implication: Played through; monitor for lingering effects but no immediate OUT.
items.conflict: Berry hates Waddle this week on volume/matchup grounds despite availability.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (TE18 vs CHI), Woody Marks (RB22 vs JAX), J.K. Dobbins (RB27 vs SEA), Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA), Justin Herbert (QB25 @ KC). Ugly matchups + shaky volume/QB situations.
items.why: Tough defenses (SEA pass/run), low volume lately for Egbuka/Pitts, Marks tough JAX run D, Nix/Herbert low totals/ruts.
items.implication: Fade/sit in most formats; Waddle especially volatile (67% yards in one game).
items.opportunity: Negative: Waddle averaging 16.5 yards outside one outlier; avoid despite availability.
items.conflict: Waddle returned ACTIVE from Q but still hated on usage.
